findings.summary: Barrel re-export uses '.ts' extension; will fail tsc under NodeNext+verbatimModuleSyntax+no allowImportingTsExtensions (TS5097).
findings.suggested_fix: Change `export * from '../modules/auth/schema.ts'` to `export * from '../modules/auth/schema.js'`. Biome misses this; smoke wave's tsc -b will surface it.

findings.summary: ARCHITECTURE.md §2.2 assigns `user` to the `accounts` module; here it lives in `auth`. Task description acknowledges the deliberate deviation.
findings.suggested_fix: When the `accounts` module is planned, move the `user` table definition (and migration ownership) there rather than adding a second user table. Document the cross-module FK from refresh_token in conventions.md.

findings.summary: Middleware imports the eager-loaded `env` singleton; couples JWT_SECRET at module-import time and blocks DI in buildApp tests.
findings.suggested_fix: Inject the secret via a factory: export `createAuthn(secret: string)` returning a MiddlewareHandler, or read `c.get('jwtSecret')` populated by buildApp. Wave-7 buildApp will need this seam for fail-fast secret validation.

findings.summary: Accesses `user.role` via `as string` cast after `c.get('user')` returns unknown; non-object claim payload would throw TypeError instead of ForbiddenError.
findings.suggested_fix: Guard with `typeof user === 'object' && typeof (user as {role?: unknown}).role === 'string'` and throw UnauthorizedError when the shape is wrong. Or introduce a typed Hono Variables binding for `user` to remove the cast.

findings.summary: Journal `when` is hardcoded (1747353600000 = 2025-05-16); snapshot `id` is `0000_initial` rather than a UUID. Drizzle Kit generates UUIDs + current ms.
findings.suggested_fix: Regenerate the migration via `pnpm --filter @medbridge/api exec drizzle-kit generate` so subsequent generations chain by UUID; or accept the hand-authored values and add a note in conventions.md that this baseline was hand-crafted.

findings.summary: Cast `err.status as 422` launders a runtime status as a literal 422; misleading because err.status varies across AppError subclasses (401/403/404/409/...).
findings.suggested_fix: Use `err.status as ContentfulStatusCode` (import the union from `hono/utils/http-status`) so the cast reflects the actual constraint without naming a misleading literal.
